text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm prepping for Rice Shower's early
morning
training when I hear someone
arrive.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Big Brother... What
training are
we going to do today?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Big Sister... What
training are we
going to do today?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I had a really great dream last
night!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I was training with you at night in a
beautiful
field...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I was training with you at night in a
beautiful
field...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But the stars were so pretty, we stopped
in the
middle of training to gaze at them
together...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It was such a relaxing dream, but since I
got my
rest there, I know I have to work
extra hard in
training here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seems like Rice Shower got a good rest.
